cards.name: Capacitor
cards.about: A sturdy wall that soaks up hits.

cards.name: Transformer
cards.about: A lighter wall that hits hard.

cards.name: Signal Processor
cards.about: Fragile, but hits hard from three tiles away.

cards.name: Circuit Engineer
cards.about: Cheap long-range shooter. Keep it behind a wall.

cards.name: Oscillator
cards.about: Its pulse also hurts everyone next to the target.

cards.name: Power Engineer
cards.about: Quick fighter with a heavy punch.

cards.name: Relay Runner
cards.about: Very fast, very fragile. Cuts straight through mud.

cards.name: Electron
cards.about: Floats over grass and mud, fast, and hits hard up close.
